title: RS Infinity Booster FIXED
description: A Port from the original mod fixing the infinity boosters when using it in survival
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/859a24e287f72180c95e0406f0985b7e3a4c531e.png)

# You can boost your refined storage range infinitely again!

A Port from the original mod fixing the infinity boosters when using it in survival.
You can expect the same features as the original mod but fixed where necessary. It fixed mostly the mechanic when you put a card in that it drained all forge energy. Making it unusable in survival, Without a creative controller.

Both Dimension and Range card are included and 100% fixed for survival.
If we missed a fix, DM then justpetrovski on discord
